erratum: The original report remains unchanged. Its top-level reviewedAtUTC value (06:00:00Z) is later than the verified clock time available when this erratum was written (05:41:50Z), so it is invalid as a recorded review time. The actual intended historical review time cannot be recovered from the saved data and is not guessed. This erratum records only the limited fixed-WEB and current reader-field recheck performed now; it does not claim that the full article review was conducted now.
